description: This Java class configures the OpenAPI (Swagger) documentation for a Spring Boot application. It defines metadata such as API title, version, description, contact info, and license, enabling dynamic API documentation generation. The class is annotated with @Configuration and provides a @Bean method that returns an OpenAPI object with configured Info, Contact, and License objects.

classes.name: OpenApiConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for setting up OpenAPI/Swagger documentation in a Spring Boot application.

methods.name: customOpenAPI
methods.description: Creates and returns an OpenAPI object with API metadata such as title, version, description, contact info, and license.
